lines.speaker: player
lines.text: $400,000? That's enough to pay off my student loans!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wonderful! Would you like me to go over your employment contract?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Wait, I thought this was a competition?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: By signing up for the competition, you also agreed to become an employee of Fish Co.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It was in the fine print.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: By catching the prized Legendary Fish King, you'll receive a total of $400,000.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: During your stay on the island, you'll be expected to fulfill a fishing quota every three days.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Failure to meet your quota will result in your removal from the island and the loss of your chance to catch the Legendary Fish King.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your activities on the island will be monitored for our records.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That is all for now. Fish Co. reserves the right to add or remove terms from your contract at any time during your stay on the island.
